finding.description: There are two differently gated child-CTA regression tests. The feature-specific ninfer_linear_gguf_q4_mmq_child_cta_test invokes test_gguf.cpp, whose child path has no runtime SM86 check; when called without fixture/output args it returns skip 77, and the external real-fixture invocation can still exercise the ordinary fallback on a non-SM86 runtime. The new guarded public test is registered unconditionally and uses generated weights, so it does not itself establish the real-fixture exact-dump path. Thus no single registered test binds runtime-8.6 proof to the real-fixture/equality-dump test.
finding.suggested_resolution: Add the same 8.6 runtime skip guard to test_gguf.cpp when --q4-mmq-child-cta-regression is selected. Preserve the separate generated-data public bridge test, but make the real-fixture external invocation require the guard and record its output for exact all-OFF comparison.
